content:
Hi everyone, Zayn here.

I’ve just posted my first Lean4 formalisation and wanted to share it. Posting here is genuinely intimidating. This community is deep in the mathematics and I’m very much the new arrival.

The problem I’m working on: given a deterministic measure-preserving map on a finite-measure space, a preparation region, and an outcome region defined as a pullback, can you prove that empirical frequencies of repeated trials converge almost surely to the normalised measure ratio? It’s the statistical backbone of a deterministic geometric reconstruction of quantum mechanics called Constraint-Surface Dynamics, which has been cited by Helland in Foundations of Physics (2024) as one of the alternative Born-rule derivations in the current literature.

LF1 is the first formal layer. Repo and paper linked below. Feedback very welcome, especially from anyone willing to tell me where the Mathlib idioms could be better.

Repo: https://github.com/zblore/csd-lean4
Paper: https://zenodo.org/records/19472012
